title: Slash story graph (story.json)
description: Ordering and branching of scenes. Vertical progression = following `next` links; `branches` pick state-dependent outcomes. Each seam into the next section is an instant cut in the current scope.

start.description: Scene id where the story begins.

scenes.description: All scenes in the story. Each entry points at a scene file.

id.description: Stable scene identifier, unique within the story.

path.description: Project-relative path to the scene file.

next.description: Scene id that follows when progress passes the end of this scene. null or omitted = story ends here. Evaluated after `branches`.

transition.description: How the seam into `next` plays. Omitted = a hard cut.

branches.description: State-dependent outcomes: the first branch whose condition matches decides the next scene, otherwise `next` applies.

transition.description: How the seam into this branch's target plays. Omitted = a hard cut.

condition.description: State condition: true when the flag/counter `key` currently equals `equals`.

transition.description: How a boundary between two vertically stacked sections plays. Only `cut` (an instant swap at the seam) is supported in the current scope; the registry is an extension point for future seam styles.

type.description: cut = instant swap at the seam (the default when `transition` is omitted).
